description: Keep dependency updates for the pdd-kit package, its viewer and the pdd-kit.dev site predictable and reviewable: one weekly batch, majors on request, security fixes at once.

packageRules.description: Group patch and minor dependency updates into one PR.
Each major update can break on its own terms, so it waits on the Dependency Dashboard until it is requested. Security updates are not held.
GitHub Actions updates, majors included, are low risk and exercised by CI, so they share one PR.
The supported Node range is a promise to consumers, raised deliberately, never by a dependency update.

Peer ranges tell Nuxt hosts which versions the layers work with. Raising a floor to the newest release would narrow that promise for no reason, so a peer range only widens, when a new major falls outside it.

@types/node describes the oldest Node the code must run on, its engines floor, never the newest release or the Node CI installs. The package and the site both have a Node 22 floor; the major is raised by hand along with that floor.
TypeScript 7 waits until vue-tsc, typescript-eslint and tsdown's declaration build support it.
h3 2 is the Nitro 3 server layer; the site stays on h3 1 until Nuxt runs on Nitro 3.

Nuxt 4.5 drops the query from a prerendered page's address once it hydrates, so a Blueprint report on pdd-kit.dev loses its reading on refresh, Back and shared links (nuxt/nuxt#34651). Nuxt stays on 4.4 until that is fixed upstream; the advisories that 4.5.1 fixes need a running Nuxt server, and every host we ship is static.
Workflows name a Node major and take its latest release; pinning the patch only adds churn, and a new major is a deliberate change.
The e2e job's container image must match @playwright/test, so they update together, in their own PR.

Playwright image tags are a v-prefixed version with an Ubuntu suffix. The registry publishes no release dates, and an update without one never passes minimumReleaseAge, so the image follows @playwright/test, which does.

customManagers.description: The deploy jobs run a pinned Wrangler through npx.
